mapper.insert: INSERT INTO people_mobile_state(people_id, tenant_id, no_self_mobile, demo_review_json, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{peopleId}, #{tenantId}, #{noSelfMobile}, #{demoReviewJson}, #{gmtModified}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE no_self_mobile = VALUES(no_self_mobile), demo_review_json = VALUES(demo_review_json), gmt_modified = VALUES(gmt_modified)
